# Packet — popol-vuh-007: The four hundred boys die; the crab made to trap Zipacna (fols. 9r–10v)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Ma cu are cu cot vxe hul ri vmoquiquil; xa vhul cu coto colbal rib.

¶2
Cate cut ta xziquin vloc ri Zipacna, colon chu ca chiri pa hul, ta xziquin vloc: “Quix petoc, chul icama vleu, rachac hul mi xcototahic. Quiꜩih nah mi xcah vvmal. Mapa qui ta nu ziquibal lo? Are curi iziquibal xa vbi ca xohanic, queheri hun elebal, caib elebal; ix ꜭo vi ca nu tao,” xꜭha vla ri Zipacna pa vhul. Chiri cut maꜩal chi vi vloc ca ziquiah chi vla pa hul.

¶3
Are cut ca hurux vloc ri qui nima che rumal ꜭaholab; cate puch xquitarih cahoc ri che pa hul. “Ma ꜭo ma ꜭhauic; chi ca tana ta chu racuh vchi, ta camoc,” xecha chi quibil quib. Xa que hazlahic, xa pu chi maꜩalah qui vach chi qui huhunal, ta xquitarih cahoc ri che.

¶4
Are cu xꜭha cut ta xuracuh vchi, xa hupah chic xziquinic, ta xcah apanoc ri che.

¶5
“Oca mi xuꜩinic qui vꜩ mi xca bano chire! Mi xcamic. Atalabe chi taquen chu bano, chu chacuh, ta chuxoc! Vnabe la xucoh vla rib cuꜭ, chi caxol puch la, oh omuch ꜭaholab.” Xeꜭha cut, que quicot chic: “Ꜭo ri vbanic ca qui oxih, que ecouic oxih puch chi cucah lacabebal ca cabal la, oh omuch chi ꜭaholab,” xeꜭha. “Chuvec cut chi quilo; cabih puch chi quilo, mapa chi pe zanic pu vleu ta chuinoc, ta ꜫeyoc; cate cut cul chi ca ꜭux ta cucah ri ca qui,” xeꜭha cut.

¶6
Cu ta cu vloc ri Zipacna chiri pa hul, ta xquibih ꜭaholab ri. Ca chu cabih puch, ta xtubuquih zanic, que binouic, que buchuvic, ta xeculun xe che. Humah qui cayeloon iz, qui cayeloon puch rixcac Zipacna.

¶7
Ta xquil curi ꜭaholab: “Mi pa xuꜩin ri ꜭaxtoꜭ? Chi vila na zanic mi xeculun vloc, mi xetubuquih vloc, humah iz qui caien, ꜭo rixcac; ri chila na mi xca bano,” ca xeꜭha chi quibil quib. Are curi Zipacna xa vi ꜭazlic; xuꜫat vloc rizmal v vi, xa pu cu qux vloc rixcac chire, cu ya vla chiquech ri zanic.

¶8
Quehe curi xcamic xquinao omuch ꜭaholab. Cate cut xticar qui qui chi roxih, ta xecabar puch conohel ꜭaholab. E ca cabarinac chic conohel omuch ꜭaholab, mahabi ca qui na chic. Cate puch xulix ri cabal pa qui vi rumal ri Zipacna; xequiz chayatahic conohel. Mahabi chic hun, caib xcolotah chiquech ri omuch chi ꜭaholab; xecamizaxic rumal Zipacna, vꜭahol ri Vucub Caquix.

¶9
Quehe cut qui camic omuch ꜭaholab ri; xꜭha chi cut, are ri xeoc chi chumilal, ri Moꜩ vbi cumal; ve cut xa zacbal ꜩih lo.

¶10
Are chi cut chi ca biyh vchacatahic chic Zipacna rumal ri e caib ꜭaholab, Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶11
Are chic vchacatahic, vcamic Zipacna, ta xchac chic cumal ri e caib ꜭaholab, Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶12
Are chic vyoc qui ꜭux caholab ri omuch chi ꜭaholab xecamic rumal Zipacna. Xa car, xa tap chuꜩucuh chi taca, xere chirechaah hutaꜫih; pa ꜫih chi vacatic ta chuꜩucuh recha; chacab cut chi recah huyub.

¶13
Cate cut vhalvachixic hun nima tap cumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque. Are cut xquicoh ri vvach ec, ri mac ec ꜭo pa tac quechelah. Are vxul tap xuxic, pahac chi cut vcoc ꜫab; xquicoho zelabah curi vva rachac tap rihouohic. Cate cut ta xquicoh vcoc chuxe pec, chuxe nima huyub; Meauan vbi huyub, xchacatah vi.

¶14
Cate cut ta xepe ri ꜭaholab, xquicu ri Zipacna chi ya. “Apa cat be vi, at ꜭahol?” xchax curi Zipacna. “Mahabi quin be vi; xa vecha ca nu ꜩucuh, ix ꜭaholab,” xꜭha curi Zipacna. “Naquipa avecha?” “Xa car, xa tap; xma ꜭo chi vi ca nu rico. Cabihir chin canah rechaxic; maui ca nu chih chic vaih,” xꜭha Zipacna chiquech Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶15
“Huna re la tap ꜭo vla xe zivan; quiꜩih chi nima tap, ca ꜫih tala chavechaah lo. Xa coh vtio mi xrah ca chapo, ca ca xibih quib rumal. Ma chi be on ca chapa,” xeꜭha ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶16
“Qui tocoba nu vach; qui be ta ivaba, ix ꜭaholab,” xꜭha ri Zipacna. “Ma ba chi cah. Xa ta cat bec; ma zachibal tah; xa racan ha cat bec, at cu ta cul apon oc xe nima huyub; houol vla chuxe zivan; xa cat el apan oc,” xeꜭha Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶17
“Laquiba, tocob nu vach! Ma ba xuculu, ix ꜭaholab? Quix be na cu nu vaba. Ꜭo qui xo vi ri ꜩiquin chi be tah ivvbah; vetaam ꜭo vi,” xꜭha chi cut Zipacna.

¶18
Xelahic xoc na chi qui vach ꜭaholab: “La ma qui cu xchachap lo, ta xa quehe xcoh ꜩalih avumal? Ma xa maui xca tiho; xa huzuc chi tionic ri oh hupulic coh oc vbic. Cate cut ca xibih rib ri oh pacalic coh oc vbic; xa cu zcaquin chic maui chi ca rico. Cate ca vꜩ at pacalic cat oc vbic,” xuchax cut.

## Establishment log (doubtful readings, letters chosen, supralinear words — the notes must say so)

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-007 (images 0027–0029, and 0030 lines 1–9)

Read 2026-11-24 from source/pages/i0027 (from line 2, after `… xcha vloc Zipacna chiri pahul,`), i0028, i0029
and the first nine lines of i0030, in strips of about six lines at 0.85–0.9×, with 1.4–2.2× crops of every
doubtful word, checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines 20484–20898). Start: `Ma cu are cu cot …`
(0027 line 2). End: image 0029 ends mid-speech (`… chi qui vach ꜭaholab: La ma`); the boys' answer runs on nine
lines of 0030 to `… cat oc vbic, xuchax cut.` (0030 line 9). The part ends there, at the end of the speech, so
that one dialogue turn is not split across two parts; popol-vuh-008 begins at 0030 line 9 with `Vꜩ bala, …`
(Brasseur's `Utzbala, x-cha cu ri Zipacna`).

Content: Zipacna digs himself a refuge in the pit and calls up from it; the boys throw the great log down on
him and rejoice; the ants carry off his hair and nails, which he has cut for them; on the third day the boys are
drunk and Zipacna brings their house down on them; the four hundred become the Pleiades (Moꜩ). New section
(Ximénez's large A on 0028, `Are chic vchacatahic, vcamic Zipacna`): Hunahpu and Xbalanque make a false crab
under the mountain Meauan and set Zipacna on to it.

## Folios
Counting as 004–006 did (0027 = 9r): 0028 = 9v, 0029 = 10r, 0030 = 10v → `fols. 9r–10v`. The crops of 0028 and
0030 carry 9 and 10 at the top left, again consistent with the folio doubt in QUESTIONS.md (2026-11-24); the
earlier count is kept.

## Letter rule used (002–006's rules, unchanged)
- g-shaped letter → ꜭ: `ꜭaholab` (all but one, below), `ꜭahol`, `ꜭaxtoꜭ`, `ꜭazlic`, `ꜭo` (all), gh → ꜭh:
  `xꜭha`, `xeꜭha`, `ma ꜭhauic`.
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has q (= ꜭ): `cuꜭ` (MS `cug`), `chi ca ꜭux` (MS `chicagux`), `qui ꜭux`
  (MS `quiqux`).
- q-shaped letter (+ u) where Brasseur has g → ꜫ, u dropped: `hutaꜫih` (MS `hutaquih`), `pa ꜫih` (MS `quih`),
  `ca ꜫih tala` (MS `caquih`), `ta ꜫeyoc` (MS `queyoc`; B. gey-oc).
- tresillo → ꜫ: `vcoc ꜫab` (0029).
- plain c kept where Brasseur has g, q or k: `rixcac` ×3 (B. r'ixgag), `xecabar`, `cabarinac` (B. gabar-),
  `pacalic` ×2 (B. pagalic), `chacab` (B. ch'agab), `ma ba chi cah` (B. chi k'ah), `cot`/`coto` (as 006),
  `xticar` (B. x-tiqar).
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has q but the earlier parts print qu: `xequiz` (as 002–006's `xquiz`),
  `quechelah` (as earlier parts).
- tz ligature → ꜩ: `quiꜩih` ×2, `maꜩalah`, `xuꜩinic`, `xuꜩin`, `vꜩ` ×2, `Moꜩ`, `ꜩih`, `chuꜩucuh` ×2,
  `nu ꜩucuh`, `ꜩiquin`, `xcoh ꜩalih`.
- ß-ligature read ti (as 005–006): `xca tiho` (MS `xcaßho`).
- plain ch for the verb of speaking where it is elsewhere gh, printed as written (as 006): `xecha chi quibil
  quib` (0027), `xchax curi Zipacna` (0029, passive, as Brasseur).

## Doubtful readings and decisions against Brasseur
- 0027 l.3 `ri vmoquiquil`: the image is clear (`vmoquiquil`); Brasseur's OCR has `ri u iki`. Perhaps muq 'bury'
  ('his burial', B. 'pour tombeau'), but the letters are o, not u. Printed as read.
- 0027 l.5–6 `colon chu ca`: a blot covers the third letter of `chu?a`; Brasseur's OCR has `7 chu ca` (the
  first word garbled). Read `chu ca` with Brasseur; `colon` is clear in the image.
- 0027 l.8–10 `mi xcototahic`, `mi xcah vvmal`: the line breaks `v-|vmal`, so the MS has `vvmal` (not 006's
  `avmal` / Brasseur's vumal); printed as written.
- 0027 l.15–16 `maꜩal`: the line-initial letter has the tz ligature's t-stroke; Brasseur's OCR is garbled
  (`таа!`). Meaning unknown. `ca ziquiah`: a heavy stroke over the z makes it look like the ligature; read
  plain z with Brasseur (`ca ziquiyah`) and the verb `ziquin` of the lines before.
- 0027 l.17–18 `ca hurux vloc` (MS `cahu-|ruxvloc`); Brasseur's OCR `ca пагах uloc` (harax?). Printed as read.
- 0027 l.37 `que ecouic`: `que` is blotted, and after it `e` + a struck-through letter + `ecouic`; the struck
  letter is left out. Brasseur `que eqouic`.
- 0027 l.43 `ta ꜫeyoc`: see the letter rule; meaning unclear (B. gey-oc).
- 0027 l.47 `Ca chu cabih puch`: the image has `ca`, Brasseur `Cu`. Printed as the image.
- 0028 l.12 `xuꜫat vloc rizmal`: the letter after `xu` looks like t (and the final t is retouched); Brasseur
  `x-u gat` (q'at 'cut'). Taken as ꜫ with Brasseur, the hand being ambiguous; doubtful.
- 0028 l.13 `cu qux vloc rixcac`: q-shaped letter where Brasseur has plain c (`c'u cux`, his note 'cuz,
  scier'); kept as qu.
- 0028 l.16–17 `qui qui chi roxih`: the MS breaks `q-|ui qui`; read `qui qui` (B. qui quiy).
- 0028 l.18 `E ca cabarinac`: the image has `eca`, Brasseur `E cu`. Printed as the image.
- 0028 l.41 `qui ꜭux caholab`: `caholab` has a plain c in the image where every other instance is g (ꜭ);
  printed as written. Brasseur qaholab.
- 0028 l.44 `chi taca`: Brasseur divides `chi tak a` ('by the waters'); kept undivided as written.
- 0029 l.16 a small k-like mark above the space between `Mahabi` and `quin`; not a letter of the text, not
  printed.
- 0029 l.20 `xma ꜭo chi vi ca nu rico`: the image has `chivi`, Brasseur `chiri`. Printed as the image.
- 0029 l.29 `quib`: a small mark (b or 8) above the word; Brasseur `kib`. Printed `quib`.
- 0029 l.37 `cu ta cul`: the third word's first letter is heavily rewritten; read c with Brasseur (`c'ul`).
- 0029 l.38 `houol vla`: printed with u as written (Brasseur hovol).
- 0029 l.41 `Laquiba` (B. Lakiba) undivided as written.
- 0030 l.1 `xchachap lo` (B. x-ch' a chap-lo), as written.
- 0030 l.8 `Cate ca vꜩ`: the image has `catecavꜩ`, Brasseur `Qatecu utz`. Printed as the image.

## Word division (ours)
`mi x-` divided as in 002–006 (`mi xcototahic`, `mi xca bano`, `mi xuꜩinic`, `mi xcamic`, `mi xrah`,
`mi xeculun`, `mi xetubuquih`); `Chi vila na` (MS `chivila`); `qui ta` (MS `quita`); `chavechaah` (MS
`chavecha-|ah`); `xa racan ha` (MS `xaracanha`); `Ma chi be on` (MS `machibeon`); `vi ri ꜩiquin` (MS `xo|viri`).

## Paragraphs
Ximénez writes the stretch continuously except for the new section on 0028 (large A, `Are chic
vchacatahic`). Paragraphs are cut at speech turns and narrative joints as in 006 (18 paragraphs).
